# v26.0 WP10: Unified Single-Engine O(1) Cultural Assimilation Gradient & Pace Modifiers.
# Replaces retired oe_cul2_organic_assimilation.txt (6 rules) + oe_as2_auto_modifiers.txt (4 rules).
# Hard local negative floor: -35% cross-region (-20% terrain + -15% faith/unrest) / -15% homeland (zero Balkan 0% deadlock!).
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1A. Civic Educational & Administrative Hub (+20% local assimilation)
oe_assim_tier1_civic_hub = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		OR = {
			location_rank = location_rank:town
			location_rank = location_rank:city
			location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
		}
		local_control >= 0.50
		num_roads >= 1
		oe_as2_loc_has_edu_admin_building = yes
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.20
	local_monthly_literacy = 0.005
	local_institution_growth_modifier = 0.05
}

# 1B. High-Control Metropolis Academy Surge (+10% stacking with 1A to +30% cap in flagship cities)
oe_assim_tier1b_metropolis_academy = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		OR = {
			location_rank = location_rank:city
			location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
		}
		local_control >= 0.70
		num_roads >= 1
		OR = {
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = university
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = arts_academy
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = academy_of_sciences
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = confucian_academy
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = great_madrasa
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = al_azhar_madrasa
		}
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.10
	local_max_literacy = 5
}

# 2. Cosmopolitan Maritime Port or Active Frontier Colony (mutually exclusive with Tier 1A; +15% assimilation)
oe_assim_tier2_port_frontier = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		NOT = {
			AND = {
				OR = {
					location_rank = location_rank:town
					location_rank = location_rank:city
					location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
				}
				local_control >= 0.50
				num_roads >= 1
				oe_as2_loc_has_edu_admin_building = yes
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_port = yes
				market_access >= 0.70
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = marketplace
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = grand_marketplace
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = wharf
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = dock
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = dry_dock
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = protected_harbor
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = customs_house
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = port_authority
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = merchants_guild
				}
			}
			has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads
			has_location_modifier = oe_col_newcomers
			has_location_modifier = oe_col_stratiotai
			has_location_modifier = oe_col_assimilating
			has_location_modifier = oe_fs_prog_loc
			has_location_modifier = oe_fs_settled
			has_location_modifier = oe_cul2_frontier_charter_loc
			has_location_modifier = oe_as2_frontier_homestead_loc_mod
		}
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.15
	local_merchant_power = 0.10
	local_migration_attraction = 0.10
}

# 3. Cross-Region Unroaded / Low-Control Terrain Friction (-20%; strictly cross-region so homeland Balkans never stall)
oe_assim_tier3_terrain_friction = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		is_capital = no
		owner = {
			capital ?= {
				region != root.region
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
				local_control < 0.35
			}
			AND = {
				num_roads = 0
				OR = {
					topography = mountains
					vegetation = desert
					vegetation = jungle
					climate = arctic
				}
			}
		}
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = -0.20
}

# 4. Faith Mismatch & Unrest Resistance (-15%; with Tier 3 hard-capped at -35% max)
oe_assim_tier4_faith_unrest_drag = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		is_capital = no
		exists = dominant_culture
		NOT = { dominant_culture = owner.culture }
		OR = {
			average_satisfaction < 0.35
			AND = {
				oe_as2_loc_religion_mismatch = yes
				local_control < 0.50
			}
		}
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = -0.15
	local_separatism = 0.03
}

# 5. Track B Foederati Metropolis (accepted minority urban dividend)
oe_assim_track_b_foederati_city = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		oe_as2_loc_owner_foederati_track = yes
		is_city = yes
		oe_as2_loc_is_accepted_minority = yes
	}
	local_production_efficiency = 0.08
	local_manpower_modifier = 0.10
	local_merchant_power = 0.12
	local_unrest = -0.05
}

# 6. Track B Foederati Rural Autonomy (-10% assimilation, +10% levies, -0.05 separatism)
oe_assim_track_b_foederati_rural = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		oe_as2_loc_owner_foederati_track = yes
		is_city = no
		oe_as2_loc_is_accepted_minority = yes
	}
	local_levy_size_modifier = 0.10
	local_separatism = -0.05
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = -0.10
}

# 7. WP10-3 Tier-2 Unitary Romanitas Fusion (+50% local fusion of derived Greek/Roman cultures into primary culture)
oe_assim_tier2_unitary_romanitas = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		owner = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_as2_ms75_roman_integration_mod
		}
		oe_as2_loc_is_derived_roman_non_primary = yes
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.50
}

# 8A. Game Rule Pace — Historical Slow (O(1) country auto_modifier)
oe_assim_pace_historical_auto = {
	type = country
	category = country
	potential_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_rule_is_assim_pace_historical = yes
	}
	global_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = -0.25
	global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = -0.20
}

# 8B. Game Rule Pace — Active Romanization (O(1) country auto_modifier)
oe_assim_pace_active_auto = {
	type = country
	category = country
	potential_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_rule_is_assim_pace_active = yes
	}
	global_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.35
	global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = 0.25
}
